I replied in the #strategic-pod thread: the Orlavine Medical Supply count is 50 seats.

Moss's 30 Sep digest says 55. Gideon Sato posted in that channel on Oct 14 that 55 is wrong and that he'd asked Moss to fix it. I couldn't find an Orlavine account file to check the number independently, so Gideon's post is the only source for 50. I said that in the reply.
